name: mobile/checkbox
description: A mobile-first circular checkbox and checkbox group for phone-sized forms. The whole row toggles. Group membership is tracked by value without inverting sibling state.
useCases: Agree-to-terms and single boolean rows on a phone form
Multi-select filters such as tags or categories on a compact surface
Settings lists where the entire row should be the tap target
Grouped options that report the selected value array on every change
